title: FinzyTrack Recipe
description: JSON shape of a dashboard or widget recipe authored by the AI assistant or by a user. Source of truth for both validation and the prompt-doc appendix. Function-typed fields (transform, getValueLink, etc.) on the runtime TypeScript types are deliberately excluded — only serialisable fields appear here.

ValueFormat.description: Predefined value formatter applied at render time.

name.description: SQL placeholder name (referenced as :name in queries).

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the parameter UI.

default.description: Default value, or a generator object {"$gen": "name"} resolved at runtime.

options.description: Either a literal array of {value, label} options, or a generator reference like {"$gen": "monthOptions"} resolved to an array at runtime.

optionsFrom.description: Populate options dynamically from the user's ledger. 'accounts' = all accounts; 'expenseAccounts'/'incomeAccounts' = only that type. Each option's value is the full account path; its label is the path below the type root (e.g. 'Expenses:Insurance:Health' → 'Insurance:Health').

hidden.description: When true, the parameter is functional (its default applies, it can be set by a `select` click or the URL, and steps read it) but renders NO control in the parameter bar. Use for a parameter driven only by click-to-select master-detail.

JsonRouteLinkConfig.description: NAVIGATE click action: clicking the value/row/series routes to a Vue route with a templated query.

JsonSelectLinkConfig.description: SELECT click action: clicking sets dashboard parameters from the clicked context INSTEAD of navigating, re-running the widgets that depend on them (master-detail drill-down).

select.description: Dashboard-parameter name → template ({{row.field}}, {{data.field}}, {{parameters.x}}). E.g. {"account": "{{row.account}}"} makes a row click drive an account-scoped drill-down widget.

JsonValueLinkConfig.description: A click action on a widget value/row/series: either NAVIGATE to a route or SELECT dashboard parameters (master-detail).

valueField.description: Column to read the value from (default: 'value').

multiCurrency.description: Group amounts by currency. Query must return currency and amount columns.

colorBySign.description: Colour the value (and icon) by sign — green when ≥ 0, red when negative. Use for figures where negative is bad, e.g. a Remaining/over-budget KPI.

seriesClickLinks.description: Per-series click links keyed by series name. Set to null to disable for that series.

emptyText.description: Message shown when the table has no rows (default: 'No data available').

rowHeader.description: Label for the row header column (default: 'Account').

colorByValue.description: Tint each cell by its numeric value read as a budget-usage fraction (e.g. pctUsed) — a budget-adherence heat-map. Uses the same green/amber/blue/red status scale as budget-progress.

warnAt.description: With colorByValue: fraction where a cell turns amber ('approaching'). Default 0.85.

colors.description: With colorByValue: override the status colours (hex), same keys as budget-progress. Omitted statuses keep the default palette.

JsonBudgetProgressVisualization.description: Budget-vs-actual progress list: one row per budgeted account with a fill bar (spent vs budget, over-budget in red) and amounts. Consumes the flat rows from the joinBudgetActual transform. Not an ECharts chart — a purpose-built Vue component.

accountField.description: Row field for the account label (default: 'account').

budgetField.description: Row field for the budget amount (default: 'budget').

actualField.description: Row field for the actual spend (default: 'actual').

remainingField.description: Row field for remaining = budget - actual (default: 'remaining').

pctUsedField.description: Row field for the fraction of budget used, e.g. 1.23 = 123% (default: 'pctUsed').

currencyField.description: Row field for the currency code (default: 'currency').

directionField.description: Row field holding 'under-good' | 'over-good' (expense vs income). Default 'direction'; absent → under-good.

accountFormat.description: Optional format for the account label (e.g. 'accountName2').

warnAt.description: Fraction of budget where a bar turns amber ('approaching'). Default 0.85 (85%).

colors.description: Override the status bar colours (any CSS/hex colour, applied in both light and dark mode). Omitted statuses keep the default palette (green/amber/blue/red).

link.description: Optional per-row click-through (interpolates {{row.<field>}}), e.g. to the account's transactions.

emptyText.description: Message shown when there are no rows.

StepId.description: Step identifier, unique within a recipe. Referenced from other steps as {{steps.<id>}} (or {{dashboard.steps.<id>}} for a dashboard shared step). Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

query.description: A read-only query against the ledger, in the dialect of the chosen `engine` (SQL for sqlite, BQL for beanquery). Use :paramName for recipe-parameter placeholders. {{...}} step references are NOT allowed here — a query step is a leaf data source and cannot read another step's rows.

engine.description: Query engine for this step. `sqlite` (default) runs SQL against the SQLite mirror; `beanquery` runs Beancount Query Language (BQL).

fn.description: Name of a server-side compute function (fixed catalog; see get_compute_functions). Validated server-side.

args.description: Scalar arguments for the compute function. Values may be literals or {{params.x}} / {{steps.x}} / {{dashboard.steps.x}} template strings. Pass only small scalars — bulk data is read server-side by the function, not shuttled through the client.

fn.description: Name of a client-side transform from the fixed catalog (none, firstRow, firstValue, sortBy, limit, pluck, where, pivot, joinBudgetActual, joinByPeriod, runningSum, envelopeRollover). Validated server-side.

inputs.description: Ordered {{steps.<id>}} / {{dashboard.steps.<id>}} references to the step outputs this transform consumes.

config.description: Transform-specific configuration; the accepted shape depends on fn (see the transform catalog in the schema doc).

Step.description: A single node in a recipe's data-pipeline DAG. Discriminated on `kind`.

Steps.description: The recipe's data pipeline as an array of named steps. Array order is for readability only; execution order is the topological sort of {{steps.*}} references. Step ids must be unique.

gridArea.description: CSS grid-area: 'row-start / col-start / row-end / col-end' (1-based, e.g. '1 / 1 / 2 / 4').

RecipeId.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Must start and end alphanumeric (e.g. 'my-dashboard-name').

JsonWidgetRecipe.description: An inline widget inside a dashboard. Widgets are never stored or referenced standalone — each lives in its enclosing dashboard's widgets[]. schemaVersion is stamped on the dashboard, not here.

output.description: Id of the step whose output feeds the visualization. Required; must name a step in this widget's steps[].

JsonDashboardRecipe.description: The only recipe type. Owns layout, parameters, optional shared steps, and an array of inline widget definitions.

schemaVersion.description: Recipe format version. Always 2 for the steps/DAG format. Files without it are rejected (run the migration).

steps.description: Optional dashboard-level shared steps. Run once per dashboard render; widgets reference them via {{dashboard.steps.<id>}}. There is no dashboard-level output.

columns.description: Total columns in the grid (12 typical).

widgets.description: Inline widget definitions (non-empty). Each widget's id is the layout.widgets[].widgetId target within this dashboard.
